background: Aldermore is a UK specialist lender owned by South Africa's FirstRand, funded by online retail and business savings and lending on buy-to-let and owner-occupied mortgages, asset finance and invoice finance, with MotoNovo in motor finance.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the bank, at BBB+ on a negative outlook, so the grade is investment-grade but with a warning attached; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by that one on 16 Jan 2026. The ratios are middling for a UK mid-sized bank: CET1 of 13.6% is a touch below the peer median, leverage of 8.3% is above the peer median, and both LCR of 170% and NSFR of 129% sit below their medians. The trend is the concern: since 30 Jun 2023 CET1 has fallen 1.2 points and LCR 41 points. Nothing flagged in the last 90 days.
